name: What is the cost impact of good plumbing sub-trade coordination versus poor coordination?

mainEntity.name: What is the cost impact of good plumbing sub-trade coordination versus poor coordination?

acceptedAnswer.text: Good plumbing sub-trade coordination can significantly reduce overall project costs by preventing expensive rework, avoiding schedule delays that incur daily charges, and minimizing material waste. It ensures trades work efficiently without conflicting, leading to a smoother project flow. Conversely, poor coordination often results in unforeseen change orders, extended project timelines, and disputes between trades, all of which drive up labor and material costs, potentially exceeding the initial budget by a substantial margin.
acceptedAnswer.description: Good coordination reduces costs by preventing rework and delays; poor coordination increases costs through change orders, extended timelines, and disputes.
